analysis_md:
解：$L:\begin{cases}x=x\\y=\sqrt{2x-x^2}\end{cases}\quad x:0\to1$，由 $0<1$，故在 $(x,y)$ 处切向量为 $\left(1,\frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^2}}\right)$，所以

$$\cos\alpha=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^2}}\right)^2}}=\sqrt{2x-x^2},\quad\cos\beta=\frac{\frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^2}}}{\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{1-x}{\sqrt{2x-x^2}}\right)^2}}=1-x$$，所以

$$\int_LP(x,y)dx+Q(x,y)dy$$

$$=\int_L[P(x,y)\cos\alpha+Q(x,y)\cos\beta]ds$$

$$=\int_L[\sqrt{2x-x^2}P(x,y)+(1-x)Q(x,y)]ds$$
